events.title: Google DeepMind launches Humanity's First Exam for LLM reliability
events.title_zh: Google DeepMind 发布 HFE 可靠性评测
events.summary: Google DeepMind launched Humanity's First Exam (HFE), a reliability benchmark with 544 elementary text and image prompts grouped into 136 four-prompt families across 20 capabilities. It tests whether models answer small variations consistently, not whether they solve a hard task once. The public Kaggle sample is smaller than the held-out evaluation, and the stress-test selection does not estimate ordinary production failure rates.
events.summary_en: Google DeepMind launched Humanity's First Exam (HFE), a reliability benchmark with 544 elementary text and image prompts grouped into 136 four-prompt families across 20 capabilities. It tests whether models answer small variations consistently, not whether they solve a hard task once. The public Kaggle sample is smaller than the held-out evaluation, and the stress-test selection does not estimate ordinary production failure rates.
events.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 发布 Humanity's First Exam（HFE）：544 道基础文本与图像题，按 136 组轻微改写组织，覆盖 20 项能力。它测的是模型能否稳定答对同一问题的不同说法，而不是偶尔解出一道难题。公开 Kaggle 样本小于完整保留集，题目也刻意选自模型容易失败的区域，不能当作生产故障率。
events.why_it_matters: Evaluation teams get a compact way to measure answer stability under harmless prompt variation, but should not turn its stress-test score into a claim about everyday user reliability.
events.why_it_matters_en: Evaluation teams get a compact way to measure answer stability under harmless prompt variation, but should not turn its stress-test score into a claim about everyday user reliability.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对评测团队来说，它提供了一个检查无害改写是否改变答案的紧凑方法；但压力测试分数不能直接外推为日常用户场景的可靠率。

events.title: Tencent opens OmniEVIE-4B for multimodal retrieval
events.title_zh: Tencent 开放多模态检索模型 OmniEVIE-4B
events.summary: Tencent released OmniEVIE-4B, a 4.54B-parameter Apache-2.0 retrieval model for text, images, visual documents and native video. It ships weights, inference and indexing code, checksums and a technical report. Its multi-vector index can localize matching page regions or video intervals, while all reported quality and latency results are publisher-run.
events.summary_en: Tencent released OmniEVIE-4B, a 4.54B-parameter Apache-2.0 retrieval model for text, images, visual documents and native video. It ships weights, inference and indexing code, checksums and a technical report. Its multi-vector index can localize matching page regions or video intervals, while all reported quality and latency results are publisher-run.

events.why_it_matters: Multimodal RAG teams can test one self-hosted retriever across documents and video with fine-grained localization, instead of stitching together separate text and vision stacks.

events.title: OpenAI shows GPT-6 can design proteins, with specialist help
events.title_zh: OpenAI 展示 GPT-6 蛋白质设计能力
events.summary: OpenAI reports that GPT-6 models can generate protein backbones and reason about sequence changes with general coding tools. In lab work with Onava, GPT-6.2-derived designs showed binding evidence across five targets, and redesigned antibodies retained binding. Candidate selection still used specialist biology models, the strongest system is internal, and binding alone does not establish specificity, stability, safety or therapeutic efficacy.
events.summary_en: OpenAI reports that GPT-6 models can generate protein backbones and reason about sequence changes with general coding tools. In lab work with Onava, GPT-6.2-derived designs showed binding evidence across five targets, and redesigned antibodies retained binding. Candidate selection still used specialist biology models, the strongest system is internal, and binding alone does not establish specificity, stability, safety or therapeutic efficacy.
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 报告称，GPT-6 系列可以用通用编码工具生成蛋白质骨架，并推断序列变化。与 Onava 的实验中，基于 GPT-6.2 的设计在五个靶点上出现结合证据，重新设计的抗体也保留结合能力。候选筛选仍依赖专用生物模型，最强系统没有公开；结合成功也不能证明特异性、稳定性、安全性或治疗效果。
events.why_it_matters: For scientific-agent teams, the result suggests general models can coordinate parts of molecular design, but it is not evidence for an end-to-end autonomous drug-design system.
events.why_it_matters_en: For scientific-agent teams, the result suggests general models can coordinate parts of molecular design, but it is not evidence for an end-to-end autonomous drug-design system.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对科学 agent 团队来说，这说明通用模型可能承担部分分子设计工作；但它还不能证明端到端自主药物设计已经可用。

events.title: Delegent lets coding agents hand bounded work to local small models
events.title_zh: Delegent 让编码 agent 把子任务交给本地小模型
events.summary: Delegent is an Apache-2.0 Claude Code harness that keeps a frontier model in charge while delegating bounded investigation, testing and search tasks to a local small model. The authors report 67% lower frontier-model cost on DeepSWE and 59% lower cost on a 694-question search evaluation without fewer solved tasks or correct answers. Code, tests and reproduction instructions are public, but the results are author-run and adoption is minimal.
events.summary_en: Delegent is an Apache-2.0 Claude Code harness that keeps a frontier model in charge while delegating bounded investigation, testing and search tasks to a local small model. The authors report 67% lower frontier-model cost on DeepSWE and 59% lower cost on a 694-question search evaluation without fewer solved tasks or correct answers. Code, tests and reproduction instructions are public, but the results are author-run and adoption is minimal.
events.summary_zh: Delegent 是一个 Apache-2.0 的 Claude Code harness。前沿模型仍负责任务总控，只把调查、测试和搜索等边界清楚的子任务交给本地小模型。作者自报在 DeepSWE 上减少 67% 的前沿模型成本，在 694 道搜索题上减少 59%，且完成量未下降。代码、测试与复现说明已公开，但结果仍是作者自测，采用信号很弱。
events.why_it_matters: Coding-agent teams can test a delegation pattern that reduces expensive context rereads without handing the whole task to a weaker router-selected model.
events.why_it_matters_en: Coding-agent teams can test a delegation pattern that reduces expensive context rereads without handing the whole task to a weaker router-selected model.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对编码 agent 团队来说，可以测试一种更细粒度的降本方法：总任务仍由强模型负责，只把低风险子任务下放，而不是整单切换到弱模型。

events.title: Google makes eight Workspace MCP servers GA and sets agent access rules
events.title_zh: Google 开放八个 Workspace MCP 服务并规定 agent 接入方式
events.summary: Google lists eight Workspace MCP servers as generally available and says AI agents accessing Workspace data must use MCP from February 1, 2027. Direct REST access remains possible but is capped at Standard Tier quotas for agentic use. Standard Tier GA MCP projects receive up to 5,000 no-cost requests per day; Scaled Tier Gmail, Calendar and Drive MCP usage is billed from the first successful request starting April 1, 2027.
